direction: Hoefler & Co.-inspired editorial Greek, independent AI concept
authorship: Independent AI synthesis; not a Hoefler & Co. design or a copy of Mercury Text.
postprocessing: None: original copied without editing or upscaling.
useful_specific_ideas: Forward, open italic nu gesture with a pointed base but a less upright-wedge silhouette; upsilon remains a rounded bowl.
Beta uses unequal bowls and a poised waist; theta keeps a broad oval with a firm, slightly rising crossbar.
Xi separates three rhythmic turns and a flowing terminal; omega balances broad lobes around a restrained centre.
The bold family suggests counter articulation and firm terminals rather than simply uniform stroke growth.

The two short formulas look broadly coherent, but raster math/text correctness has not been certified.
